sentences.en: For comfortable weekly shopping you have to have a car.
sentences.zh: 为了方便每周购物，你得有一辆车。

sentences.en: Mr Miura brought an action of libel against a weekly magazine.
sentences.zh: 米ura先生因诽谤状告了一份周刊杂志。

sentences.en: I don't usually say anything at our weekly meetings.
sentences.zh: 我们每周例会上通常不会说什么。
